values.note: RV sites with electric, plus tax: interior $45 a night May-October and $50 November-April; waterfront $50 and $60.

fees.source: https://www.martin.fl.us/rv-sites ('Waterfront RV Site Rates with Electric: Nov. 1 – April 30: $60.00 plus tax per night; May 1 – Oct. 31: $50.00 ...'; 'Interior RV Site Rates with Electric: Nov. 1 – April 30: $50.00 ...; May 1 – Oct. 31: $45.00 plus tax per night'), read 2026-10-21

hookups.source: https://www.martin.fl.us/rv-sites ('99 RV (recreational vehicle) spots, each equipped with 20/30/50-amp electric service, water and sewer hookups'), read 2026-10-21

values.note: 58 waterfront and 41 interior RV sites, each with a picnic table and fire pit; 2 vehicles, or 1 vehicle + trailer, per site on the gravel, and a boat may be parked on the site. No personal tents; 19 rental canvas 'Adventure Tent' sites November 1 - May 31.

sites.source: https://www.martin.fl.us/rv-sites ('Choose from 58 waterfront and 41 interior sites, totaling 99 RV ... spots') + https://www.martin.fl.us/Phipps ('19 Adventure Tent sites ... Seasonal availability (Nov 1–May 31)', 'We do not allow personal tent camping', '2 vehicles or 1 vehicle + trailer per site in the gravel area', 'You can bring a boat; park on your RV site or at the boat ramp'), read 2026-10-21

values.note: Boat ramp and dock, fishing pier, picnic pavilions, waterfront boardwalks; firewood sold at the office.

facilities.source: https://www.martin.fl.us/Phipps (Campground Amenities: 'Boat ramp and dock', 'Hot water showers', 'Fishing pier', 'Free WiFi', 'Laundry facilities', 'Picnic pavilions', 'Restrooms'), read 2026-10-21

values.note: Book online through the county's FireFly page at least 24 hours before arrival, so the after-hours gate code can be sent. RV stays are capped at 90 days within a consecutive 300-day period. Check-in from 3 p.m.; gate open 6 a.m. to 7:30 p.m.

booking.source: https://www.martin.fl.us/rv-sites ('RV camping is limited to a maximum stay of 90 days within a consecutive 300-day period', 'Reservations must be made 24-hours in advance of arrival to allow time to provide the gate code') + https://www.martin.fl.us/Phipps ('Check-in: Begins at 3 p.m.', 'Gate opens at 6 a.m., closes at 7:30 p.m.'; Make a Reservation link), read 2026-10-21

note: Martin County 55-acre conservation park & campground on the Okeechobee Waterway (St. Lucie Canal) at the St. Lucie Lock & Dam, Stuart - a distinct facility adjacent to (not the same as) the federal St. Lucie South Campground. --Claude
summary: Confirmed on Martin County's pages: interior $45-50 / waterfront $50-60 plus tax, 99 RV sites (58 waterfront, 41 interior) with 20/30/50-amp, water and sewer, showers/laundry/free WiFi, reservable on FireFly 24 h ahead, 90-day max in 300 days.
